title: Nuevo Laredo's Posada del Compartir expects 10,000 people for a free Christmas-season meal on Dec. 5
excerpt: Cáritas de Nuevo Laredo will hold its Posada del Compartir 2026 on Saturday, Dec. 5, expecting about 10,000 people for a free meal and family activities, with support from H-E-B and Mi Tienda del Ahorro.
content:
Cáritas de Nuevo Laredo will hold its Posada del Compartir 2026 on Saturday, Dec. 5, expecting about 10,000 people to gather for a free meal and family activities, according to Hoy Tamaulipas.

The event is organized by Cáritas de Nuevo Laredo in coordination with the supermarket chains H-E-B and Mi Tienda del Ahorro. Doors open at 9 a.m., when attendees will receive bread and food products provided by sponsors and suppliers. A protocol ceremony is scheduled for noon, and the main meal will be served at about 1:30 p.m.

Adults will be served turkey with side dishes, while children will receive pizza and spaghetti. Recreational activities for families are also planned. Entry and food are free, but capacity is limited and each person must present a ticket to enter.

This is the 22nd in-person edition of the Posada del Compartir. The event has been held for 24 years in total, including two pandemic years when food-pantry distributions continued in place of the gathering. Its purpose is to offer a hot meal to thousands of people and support families who need food assistance during the December celebrations.

The event was announced by Presbítero Rogelio Lozano Alcorta, president of Cáritas de Nuevo Laredo, with Cáritas member Elda Elizondo also taking part. Representatives of H-E-B and Mi Tienda del Ahorro reaffirmed their participation, and organizers asked the media to help publicize the event and distribute passes to people who need assistance.

Sources: Hoy Tamaulipas, “Preparan Posada del Compartir para 10 mil personas en Nuevo Laredo” (Nov. 12, 2026); El Mañana de Nuevo Laredo, “Prepara DIF Posada del Compartir para 10 mil personas en Nuevo Laredo” (Nov. 12, 2026).
